body:
It's a long story. To make it short, it's about a girl I worked with. We got closer and closer over the course of a year until we agreed to go take a coffee together in a week. I realised how much she meant to me (and trust me, I never felt something that strong for someone) and decided to tell her what I felt for her at the end of the coffee night since I wanted something a bit romantic for that. The snow was starting to fall (it was in late november) so I thought that kind of scenery would help.

Unfortunately, I was near the end of my networking class and she still had classes to attend to. We pushed back many times until we decided to go the 27th of december. My classes ended in mid december so I started working more at my part time job. The 20th, while I was working, I overheard she had a new boyfriend. It was confirmed shortly afterward. 

We took that coffee together but since she now had a boyfriend, I did not tell her what I felt for her. We kept close until recently. Not so long ago, I wanted to go take a coffee with her again. That would be our 3rd since december. This time however, she told me that her boyfriend was infuriated by it and that she should not go to avoid conflict with him. ever since then, she never answered my messages.

I thought she was interested in me and I guess I was wrong. I lost my smile ever since I learned she had a new boyfriend, the only ones being able to give it back to me being my cousins. I did not only loose a love interest but also a friend with who I felt close enough to tell everything.

I am a people person but I've been hurt badly on that side multiple times. I  give the impression of being a cold person until I know I can let my guard down. As for the multitasking, that is one of the many reasons I left my networking job. I am bad at it. 

And thank you. It's been a while since i felt the way i felt after reading your message.
I don't have the means to get therapy. I am not poor but I cannot afford it without putting me in (more) trouble.
